translations.name: Legal Services of Eastern Missouri
translations.description: Legal Services of Eastern Missouri gives free legal help. It helps older adults and people with low incomes. Help also depends on the type of legal problem. You must live in one of the 21 eastern Missouri counties they serve. You can apply online or call 314-534-4200 or 800-444-0514. They do not handle criminal cases.
translations.website_description: Apply for free legal help in eastern Missouri
